newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH UTILITY PLANS CZK 600 MLN IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: CZECH UTILITY PLANS CZK 600 MLN IN 1997.

text.p: Prague-based Prazska Plynarenska a.s., the third largest Czech gas distributor, said on Thursday that it plans to issue a 600 million crown tranche of bonds this year.
Plynarenska officials did not release any further details of the issue.
Plynarenska posted a 1996 unconsolidated net profit of 86 million crowns, down from 124 million in 1995.
The state holds a 49 percent stake in the utility through the National Property Fund, while the city of Prague has a 34 percent share, and German utility RWE holds 12 percent.
